Citywalk Map Skill 2.0.0 introduces a more powerful and user-friendly citywalk route map generator.

- Uses real OpenStreetMap basemaps and OSRM for accurate walking routes.
- Supports custom theme colors and a responsive screen-wide layout for both desktop and mobile.
- Automatically fetches missing coordinates and fits the map to all waypoints.
- Calculates realistic walking times (5 km/h), displays total distance, time, and stop info.
- One-click HTML map generation and automated screenshot delivery via Feishu.
- Detailed documentation and flexible CLI usage, with clear color scheme guidance and practical tips.
